issues.title: Bug with secondary/revised fields metadata for duplication
issues.description: While testing version 4.2.7 for the platform migration we discovered an issue with the RFP Release Date and the RFP Release Date revised fields. The duplicate field for the rfp release date revised can be set to true while the RFP Release Date has duplicate set to false. This results in the RFP Release Date being null while the hidden field for the RFP Release Date Revised contains a date. This issue was uncovered while reviewing reports during the platform migration. When a primary field's metadata for duplicate or required is defined; the secondary field should replicate those settings. Remove the ability to define metadata for secondary fields and set them to inherit the settings defined for the primary field.
